description: This file defines the TalkModeManager class, which manages voice interactions in an Android application. It handles speech recognition, text-to-speech synthesis, chat session management, and related audio focus and recognition lifecycle. The class coordinates listening, speech processing, and playback workflows to enable a conversational voice interface with features like wake-word detection, chat subscription, and dynamic configuration reloads.

classes.name: TalkModeManager
classes.description: Manages voice interaction features such as speech recognition, TTS playback, chat session management, and configuration handling within an Android app to facilitate a conversational voice interface.

methods.name: ensureChatSubscribed
methods.description: Ensures the chat session is subscribed on the gateway, optionally loading configuration.

methods.name: setMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the session key used for chat subscription and history retrieval.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables voice listening and interaction workflows.

methods.name: speakWakeCommand
methods.description: Performs a wake-word command by sending chat input, waiting for response, and playing assistant reply.

methods.name: playTtsForText
methods.description: Plays a given text as TTS output.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Handles external gateway events related to chat, updating state or triggering TTS as needed.

methods.name: setPlaybackEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables playback of assistant responses.

methods.name: refreshConfig
methods.description: Reloads configuration parameters from the gateway.

methods.name: speakAssistantReply
methods.description: Speaks a given assistant reply text, optionally with playback configurations.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts voice recognition listening if possible.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops voice recognition and related audio sessions.

methods.name: startListeningInternal
methods.description: Internal method to initiate speech recognition listening.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules restart of recognition after errors or end of speech.

methods.name: handleTranscript
methods.description: Handles incoming speech recognition results and manages transcript and state.

methods.name: startSilenceMonitor
methods.description: Begins monitoring for speech silence to finalize recognition.

methods.name: checkSilence
methods.description: Checks if the silence timeout has been exceeded to finalize recognition.

methods.name: finalizeTranscript
methods.description: Handles the end of recognition, sending chat, and responding via TTS.

methods.name: subscribeChatIfNeeded
methods.description: Subscribes to chat updates if supported and not already subscribed.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Builds a prompt string combining wake-word, context, and transcript for sending.

methods.name: sendChat
methods.description: Sends chat message to the session and retrieves run ID.

methods.name: waitForChatFinal
methods.description: Waits for chat response to finalize with timeout.

methods.name: cacheRunCompletion
methods.description: Caches the completion status of a chat run.

methods.name: consumeRunCompletion
methods.description: Consumes and removes cached run completion status.

methods.name: consumeRunText
methods.description: Consumes and removes cached chat run text.

methods.name: extractTextFromChatEventMessage
methods.description: Extracts text content from chat event message JSON elements.

methods.name: waitForAssistantText
methods.description: Waits for the latest assistant message with a timeout.

methods.name: fetchLatestAssistantText
methods.description: Fetches the latest assistant message from chat history.

methods.name: playAssistant
methods.description: Handles the playback of assistant message text, including directive parsing and TTS.

methods.name: runPlaybackSession
methods.description: Runs a playback session, managing TTS playback lifecycles.

methods.name: cancelActivePlayback
methods.description: Cancels current assistant playback.

methods.name: speakWithSystemTts
methods.description: Speaks text using the system TTS engine with directives and progress tracking.

methods.name: stopTts
methods.description: Stops any ongoing TTS playback.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Stops speaking and resets recognition and audio focus.

methods.name: shouldAllowSpeechInterrupt
methods.description: Determines if speech recognition can be interrupted.

methods.name: clearListenWatchdog
methods.description: Cancels the silence watchdog job.

methods.name: requestAudioFocusForTts
methods.description: Requests audio focus for TTS playback.

methods.name: abandonAudioFocus
methods.description: Releases audio focus.

methods.name: ensureTextToSpeech
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves the TextToSpeech engine.

methods.name: stopTextToSpeechPlayback
methods.description: Stops TTS playback.

methods.name: shutdownTextToSpeech
methods.description: Shuts down TTS engine and clears references.

methods.name: shouldInterrupt
methods.description: Determines if new speech input should interrupt current speech.

methods.name: ensurePlaybackActive
methods.description: Verifies current playback is active for given token.

methods.name: isPlaybackCancelled
methods.description: Checks whether playback was canceled.

methods.name: ensureConfigLoaded
methods.description: Ensures configuration parameters are loaded.

methods.name: reloadConfig
methods.description: Reloads configuration from the session, applies defaults on failure.

methods.name: parseRunId
methods.description: Parses run ID from JSON string.
